dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains the 886 census blocks that make up the City of Cambridge for the 2000 Census. Data from US Bureau of the Census. GIS Data layer created by City of Cambridge GIS using Census TIGER/Lines. Adjusted Census TIGER/Lines by conflating with Cambridge centerline, rail, and City boundary as a guide.

Purpose: Created for spatial analysis of associated Census 2000 demographic data. Used for planning, mapping, and Community Development Block Grant (CBDG) purposes by the Community Development Department.
